# google_ces_evaluation_dataset

An Evaluation Dataset is a collection of Evaluations that are used to measure the performance and quality of an App.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

## Example Usage - Ces Evaluation Dataset Basic


```hcl
resource "google_ces_app" "app" {
  provider     = google-beta
  app_id       = "app-id"
  display_name = "test-app-display-name"
  location     = "us"

  language_settings {
    default_language_code = "en-US"
  }
  time_zone_settings {
    time_zone = "America/Los_Angeles"
  }
}

resource "google_ces_evaluation_dataset" "default" {
  provider              = google-beta
  evaluation_dataset_id = "dataset-id"
  display_name          = "my-dataset"
  app                   = google_ces_app.app.app_id
  location              = "us"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `display_name` -
  (Required)
  User-defined display name of the evaluation dataset. Unique within an App.

* `location` -
  (Required)
  Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.

* `app` -
  (Required)
  Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.

* `evaluation_dataset_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID to use for the evaluation dataset, which will become the final
  component of the evaluation dataset's resource name. If not provided, a
  unique ID will be automatically assigned for the evaluation.


* `aggregated_metrics` -
  (Optional)
  Aggregated metrics for an evaluation or evaluation dataset.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_aggregated_metrics).

* `evaluations` -
  (Optional)
  Evaluations that are included in this dataset.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_aggregated_metrics"></a>The `aggregated_metrics` block supports:

* `metrics_by_app_version` -
  (Output)
  Aggregated metrics, grouped by app version ID.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_aggregated_metrics_metrics_by_app_version).


<a name="nested_aggregated_metrics_metrics_by_app_version"></a>The `metrics_by_app_version` block contains:

* `app_version_id` -
  (Output)
  The app version ID.

* `fail_count` -
  (Output)
  The number of times the evaluation failed.

* `hallucination_metrics` -
  (Output)
  Metrics for hallucination within this app version.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_aggregated_metrics_metrics_by_app_version_hallucination_metrics).

* `metrics_by_turn` -
  (Output)
  Metrics aggregated per turn within this app version.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_aggregated_metrics_metrics_by_app_version_metrics_by_turn).

* `pass_count` -
  (Output)
  The number of times the evaluation passed.

* `semantic_similarity_metrics` -
  (Output)
  Metrics for semantic similarity within this app version.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_aggregated_metrics_metrics_by_app_version_semantic_similarity_metrics).

* `tool_call_latency_metrics` -
  (Output)
  Metrics for tool call latency within this app version.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_aggregated_metrics_metrics_by_app_version_tool_call_latency_metrics).

* `tool_metrics` -
  (Output)
  Metrics for each tool within this app version.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_aggregated_metrics_metrics_by_app_version_tool_metrics).

* `turn_latency_metrics` -
  (Output)
  Metrics for turn latency within this app version.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_aggregated_metrics_metrics_by_app_version_turn_latency_metrics).


<a name="nested_aggregated_metrics_metrics_by_app_version_hallucination_metrics"></a>The `hallucination_metrics` block contains:

* `score` -
  (Output)
  The average hallucination score (0 to 1).

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/apps/{{app}}/evaluationDatasets/{{evaluation_dataset_id}}`

* `create_time` -
  Timestamp when the evaluation dataset was created.

* `created_by` -
  The user who created the evaluation dataset.

* `etag` -
  Etag used to ensure the object hasn't changed during a read-modify-write
  operation. If the etag is empty, the update will overwrite any concurrent
  changes.

* `last_updated_by` -
  The user who last updated the evaluation dataset.

* `name` -
  Identifier. The unique identifier of this evaluation dataset.
  Format:
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/evaluationDatasets/{evaluationDataset}`

* `update_time` -
  Timestamp when the evaluation dataset was last updated.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


EvaluationDataset can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/apps/{{app}}/evaluationDatasets/{{evaluation_dataset_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{app}}/{{evaluation_dataset_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{app}}/{{evaluation_dataset_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import EvaluationDataset using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    app = "<-required value->"
    evaluationDatasetId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_ces_evaluation_dataset.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import EvaluationDataset using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/apps/{{app}}/evaluationDatasets/{{evaluation_dataset_id}}"
  to = google_ces_evaluation_dataset.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), EvaluationDataset can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_ces_evaluation_dataset.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/apps/{{app}}/evaluationDatasets/{{evaluation_dataset_id}}
$ terraform import google_ces_evaluation_dataset.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{app}}/{{evaluation_dataset_id}}
$ terraform import google_ces_evaluation_dataset.default {{location}}/{{app}}/{{evaluation_dataset_id}}
```
